$schema: Master list of dolls in the atelier. Single source of truth. Update this, then sync HTML manually.
fxNote: Prices reference EUR equivalents around 1100-1700, converted to THB at ~38/EUR and rounded to the nearest 500.

dolls.name: Pickle
dolls.shortDescription: Sleeping newborn with painted dark hair and a quiet, full-cheeked face.
dolls.story: Pickle was painted across two slow weeks, layer by layer, with long pauses to let the colour settle. The hair is hand-painted in fine flowing strokes; the body is full vinyl, weighted to feel newly arrived. She has been photographed in a bear suit, a heart-print tutu, and a soft knit bunny bonnet — each look a small reminder that she is meant to be lived with, not displayed.

specs.body: Full vinyl, weighted with glass beads

dolls.name: Luisa
dolls.shortDescription: Hand-rooted newborn with full dark hair and a calm, finished face.
dolls.story: Luisa is the rooted sister of the painted-hair newborns. Each strand of her hair was placed by hand over many quiet evenings — a slow practice that asks for stillness more than skill. She arrives in the atelier's signed packaging, ready to be unwrapped.

specs.body: Soft cotton cloth, weighted with glass beads

dolls.name: Elf Fee
dolls.shortDescription: A sculpted-ear fantasy newborn with platinum curls and a quiet, watchful gaze.
dolls.story: Elf Fee is a fantasy reborn — sculpted with delicate elfin ears and given a head of platinum mohair curls. She watches more than she sleeps. The atelier dresses her with a small grey bunny so she is not alone.

specs.hair: Imported mohair, hand-rooted, soft platinum curls

dolls.name: Meadow
dolls.shortDescription: Awake ginger-haired toddler with painted lashes and a long, quiet stare.
dolls.story: Meadow is a poseable toddler with a painted ginger head and clear blue glass eyes. The atelier photographed her in a high chair with a small painted horse — the kind of unhurried play she was made for.

specs.body: Soft cotton, weighted, poseable toddler frame

dolls.name: Demi
dolls.shortDescription: Sleeping full-vinyl newborn with painted hair and a peaceful, settled face.
dolls.story: Demi is a full-vinyl newborn — bath-safe, weighted, with hand-painted hair laid down in fine flowing layers. She has been photographed beside a bottle and in soft cotton, the way the atelier imagines she will be held at home.

dolls.name: Sue Sue
dolls.shortDescription: Awake toddler with rooted auburn hair and a thoughtful expression.
dolls.story: Sue Sue is photographed both before and after — bald in early sittings, then with a head of auburn mohair rooted strand by strand. She has the quiet, slightly serious face of a child who is taking the room in.

specs.hair: Imported mohair, micro-rooted by hand, auburn
specs.body: Soft cotton, weighted, poseable toddler frame

dolls.name: June
dolls.shortDescription: Deeply sleeping newborn with painted hair and a softly settled face.
dolls.story: June is the kind of doll you photograph in everything — a corduroy bear-print outfit, a frilled bonnet, a Maxi-Cosi car seat ready for the trip home. She arrives sleeping and stays sleeping; the atelier finished her in late spring, when the light comes in slow.

specs.body: Soft cotton, weighted with glass beads

categories.newborns: Soft, sleeping or drowsy, weighted to feel newly arrived.
categories.toddlers: Older children, painted or rooted hair, more poseable.
categories.fantasy: Sculpted-ear and fantasy reborns, made for storytelling.
categories.bespoke: A reborn made from your reference photographs.
